_about: Achievements. 'counter' names a lifetime counter in the save (SaveManager counters); 'goal' is how many are needed. Achievements without a counter are unlocked by the game when they happen.

achievements.name: Corn Collector
achievements.about: Collect every gas item in a stage.

achievements.name: Tiger Tamer
achievements.about: Jump over a tiger, then fart it away.

achievements.name: Bear Bonker
achievements.about: Knock over a bear with a headbutt.

achievements.name: Super Gas
achievements.about: Fart with a full gas tank for a super fart.

achievements.name: Untouchable
achievements.about: Finish a stage without losing a heart.

achievements.name: Mighty Donkey
achievements.about: Reach level 17 and fill every stat.

achievements.name: Amazon Runner
achievements.about: Finish every stage of Earth – Amazon.

achievements.name: Desert Runner
achievements.about: Finish every stage of Earth – Desert.
